summary.en: A large generics business is developing a specialty portfolio around liver disease, biosimilars and rare diseases. Saroglitazar's US review is the most immediate disclosed innovative-drug milestone.
summary.zh: 一家大型仿制药企业正围绕肝病、生物类似药和罕见病打造专科产品组合。Saroglitazar 的美国审评是已披露的最直接的创新药里程碑。

ind.en: Primary biliary cholangitis; MASH Phase 2b completed
ind.zh: 原发性胆汁性胆管炎;MASH IIb 期已完成

watch.en: Saroglitazar's FDA target action date is November 27, 2026.
watch.zh: Saroglitazar 的 FDA 目标行动日期为 2026 年 11 月 27 日。

watch.en: Alvelestat is an option-and-license arrangement; Mereo retains global development leadership.
watch.zh: Alvelestat 为期权加许可安排;Mereo 保留全球开发主导权。

watch.en: Q2 R&D was 8.3% of revenue; September net debt/EBITDA was 0.62 times.
watch.zh: 第二季度研发占收入的 8.3%;9 月净债务/EBITDA 为 0.62 倍。

watch.en: SEZ II and Moraiya inspections had one and five observations, respectively.
watch.zh: SEZ II 和 Moraiya 检查分别有一项和五项观察项。
